findings.finding: REG-005's smooth family disproved uniform control, not literal set membership.
findings.repair: Restated the canonical and report claim as a uniform Serrin-norm estimate and calculated every Serrin pair's growth.

findings.finding: FND-003's proof artifact omitted the force term present in its statement.
findings.repair: Added the forcing inner product and integrability hypothesis; retained the unforced special case.

findings.finding: CF-06 named Proposition 5.5 rather than conditional Proposition 5.4.
findings.repair: Restored Proposition 5.4 after checking the primary paper's statement.

findings.finding: PR-13 asserted a dimension-one zero-measure Cantor set without construction or dependency.
findings.repair: Added an explicit variable-ratio Cantor set, zero-H1 cover, and mass-distribution dimension proof.

findings.finding: Three formula prefixes still contained literal tab/control bytes despite round 2's prose repair.
findings.repair: Replaced them with safe TeX commands and verified exact 0x5c prefixes and absence of 0x15.

findings.finding: Punctuation-only Markdown headings generated an empty internal anchor.
Only whitelisted claim prefixes were synchronized from documentation.
findings.repair: Made explicit inline Claim declarations and table first-cell IDs prefix-agnostic, with regression coverage.

findings.finding: docs/proofs/../ path traversal bypassed proof placement.
findings.repair: Resolved proof paths and enforced containment beneath the resolved docs/proofs directory.

findings.finding: A proved analytic theorem could depend directly on a computation claim.
findings.repair: Required an explicit settled non-computation analytic bridge for every computational dependency.

findings.finding: A converged review could hide actionable findings behind an empty unresolved list.
findings.repair: Derived acceptance constraints from finding dispositions and required rejection reasons.

findings.finding: Certification did not validate complete gauntlet history.
findings.repair: Validated contiguous round IDs, previous paths, hashes, and cycles back to round 001.

findings.finding: One JSON artifact or reviewer identity could be reused across certification roles.
findings.repair: Required typed directories, unique paths, disjoint internal/external sets, and distinct external name-affiliation pairs.

findings.finding: Local JSON model and reviewer identities remain self-attested without an external signed trust root.
findings.reason: The local validator now states this limitation; it cannot manufacture provider or human authentication.

findings.finding: Arbitrary prose can restate a Clay alternative without declaring semantic equivalence.
findings.reason: Generic claims are now canonicalized, but semantic equivalence remains a mathematical-review obligation.
